description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipeline's setPosition functionality within a media playback system. It tests the behavior of setting the playback position in various states, ensuring proper IPC communication and cleanup of data requests.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaPipelineSetPositionTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the setPosition method of the media pipeline, including setup and teardown procedures and specific test cases for valid and invalid states.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates the media pipeline, and sets the default playback state to playing.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment by destroying the media pipeline.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the pipeline, mocking the IPC call.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the media position via IPC, mocking the call.

methods.name: testNeedDataRequestRemovedOnSetPosition
methods.description: Verifies that needData requests are removed after setting position in a given playback state.

methods.name: testNeedDataRequestRemovedOnSetPosition (NetworkState version)
methods.description: Verifies that needData requests are removed after setting position in a given network state.
